candidates.headline: Ask HN: Where are all the consumer ChatGPT apps?
candidates.excerpt: Community discussion on the absence of mainstream consumer applications built on ChatGPT APIs despite years of hype.
candidates.comedy_angle: The gap between 'AI will change everything' and 'why can't I buy a useful AI app?' — perfect setup for Cody's perpetual product disappointment.

candidates.headline: Top Programmers Return to Hand-Coding Amid AI Tool Doubts
candidates.excerpt: Senior developers increasingly skeptical of AI-assisted coding quality and reliability, reverting to manual development.
candidates.comedy_angle: The irony of AI coding tools being so bad that experts reject them — Deep's 'AI is eating itself' thesis writes itself.

candidates.headline: AI slop videos aimed at babies are 'garbage,' says pediatrician
candidates.excerpt: Medical professionals warn against AI-generated content designed for infants, citing developmental and safety concerns.
candidates.comedy_angle: AI companies optimizing for 'watch time' on babies — Lana's segment on AI ethics gone absurd.

candidates.headline: Hash anchors and Myers diff and single-token anchors: 60% cheaper AI code edits
candidates.excerpt: Technical optimization reducing token costs for AI-assisted code editing by 60% through algorithmic efficiency.
candidates.comedy_angle: Yet another 'we made AI cheaper' story — Cody's running joke about cost-cutting that never reaches users.

candidates.headline: Why Every AI-Coded App Is an Island
candidates.excerpt: Analysis of architectural fragmentation and integration failures in AI-generated applications.
candidates.comedy_angle: AI apps can't talk to each other — perfect metaphor for AI companies' inability to collaborate; Cody's isolation chamber bit.

candidates.headline: Has AI Changed the Course of Drug Development? Three Years Later
candidates.excerpt: Long-form analysis questioning whether AI's promised impact on pharmaceutical R&D has materialized after three years.
candidates.comedy_angle: Three years of 'AI will cure cancer' claims, and the answer is still 'maybe?' — Sakura's reality-check segment.

candidates.headline: The AI Question That No AI Person Asks [video]
candidates.excerpt: Video essay exploring a fundamental question about AI that industry insiders consistently avoid.
candidates.comedy_angle: The unspoken elephant in the room of AI discourse — setup for Lana or Deep's meta-commentary segment.

candidates.headline: Show HN: Thelawin – Generate EU e-invoices from JSON
candidates.excerpt: Developer tool for programmatically generating EU-compliant electronic invoices from JSON input.
candidates.comedy_angle: Yet another 'AI for boring enterprise task' — filler for Compli-Anson's regulatory compliance bit if needed.

candidates.headline: Show HN: UseMoney AI: AI Copilot for Retail Investors of India
candidates.excerpt: AI-powered investment advisory tool targeting retail investors in the Indian market.
candidates.comedy_angle: AI giving financial advice to retail investors — Perp's 'AI is terrible at predicting things' bit, with India market angle.
